sloka: तेनास्य राज्ञस्तौ पादौ तदा कल्माषतां गतौ ।तदाप्रभृति राजा ऽसौ सौदासः सुमहायशाः ।कल्माषपादः संवृत्तः ख्यातश्चैव तथा नृपः ।। ७.६५.३२ ॥
transliteration: tenāsya rājñastau pādau tadā kalmāṣatāṁ gatau ।tadāprabhṛti rājā 'sau saudāsaḥ sumahāyaśāḥ ।kalmāṣapādaḥ saṁvṛttaḥ khyātaścaiva tathā nṛpaḥ ।। 7.65.32 ॥

translations.english: By that water, the king's feet then became spotted, and from that time onwards, the greatly renowned King Saudasa became known as Kalmashapada, the spotted-footed king.
